CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.audit_trigger_fn()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id uuid;
  v_record_id text;
BEGIN
  -- Prefer the JWT user (normal authenticated API calls).
  -- Fall back to the app-level context set by service-role admin calls.
  v_user_id := COALESCE(
    auth.uid(),
    NULLIF(current_setting('app.audit_user_id', true), '')::uuid
  );

  v_record_id := CASE
    WHEN TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN (OLD.id)::text
    ELSE (NEW.id)::text
  END;

  INSERT INTO audit_log (table_name, record_id, operation, user_id, old_data, new_data)
  VALUES (
    TG_TABLE_NAME,
    v_record_id,
    TG_OP,
    v_user_id,
    CASE WHEN TG_OP IN ('UPDATE','DELETE') THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN TG_OP IN ('INSERT','UPDATE') THEN to_jsonb(NEW) ELSE NULL END
  );

  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);
END;
$function$
